### Pregunta

### SQL

WITH m AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(fecha_pedido, '%Y-%m') AS mes, SUM(total) AS total FROM pedidos WHERE YEAR(fecha_pedido) = 2024 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(fecha_pedido, '%Y-%m')) SELECT mes, ROUND(total, 2) AS total, ROUND(total - LAG(total) OVER (ORDER BY mes), 2) AS diferencia FROM m ORDER BY mes

### Pregunta
Muestra para cada mes de 2025 la suma de monto pagado de los pagos y la diferencia contra el mes anterior. Devuelve mes (AAAA-MM), total y diferencia, en orden cronológico.

### SQL

WITH m AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(fecha_pago, '%Y-%m') AS mes, SUM(monto) AS total FROM pagos WHERE YEAR(fecha_pago) = 2025 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(fecha_pago, '%Y-%m')) SELECT mes, ROUND(total, 2) AS total, ROUND(total - LAG(total) OVER (ORDER BY mes), 2) AS diferencia FROM m ORDER BY mes

Para 2025, calcula la suma mensual de monto pagado de los pagos y el acumulado mes a mes. Devuelve mes (AAAA-MM), la suma del mes y el acumulado, en orden cronológico.

### SQL

WITH m AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(fecha_pago, '%Y-%m') AS mes, SUM(monto) AS total FROM pagos WHERE YEAR(fecha_pago) = 2025 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(fecha_pago, '%Y-%m')) SELECT mes, ROUND(total, 2) AS total, ROUND(SUM(total) OVER (ORDER BY mes), 2) AS acumulado FROM m ORDER BY mes

### Pregunta
Muestra para cada mes de 2025 la suma de días de las solicitudes de permiso y la diferencia contra el mes anterior. Devuelve mes (AAAA-MM), total y diferencia, en orden cronológico.

### SQL

WITH m AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(request_date, '%Y-%m') AS mes, SUM(days) AS total FROM leave_requests WHERE YEAR(request_date) = 2025 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(request_date, '%Y-%m')) SELECT mes, ROUND(total, 2) AS total, ROUND(total - LAG(total) OVER (ORDER BY mes), 2) AS diferencia FROM m ORDER BY mes

### Pregunta
Muestra para cada mes de 2024 la suma de duración en minutos de los vuelos y la diferencia contra el mes anterior. Devuelve mes (AAAA-MM), total y diferencia, en orden cronológico.

### SQL

WITH m AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(fecha_salida, '%Y-%m') AS mes, SUM(duracion_min) AS total FROM vuelos WHERE YEAR(fecha_salida) = 2024 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(fecha_salida, '%Y-%m')) SELECT mes, ROUND(total, 2) AS total, ROUND(total - LAG(total) OVER (ORDER BY mes), 2) AS diferencia FROM m ORDER BY mes

WITH m AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(fecha_reserva, '%Y-%m') AS mes, SUM(precio) AS total FROM reservas WHERE YEAR(fecha_reserva) = 2024 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(fecha_reserva, '%Y-%m')) SELECT mes, ROUND(total, 2) AS total, ROUND(total - LAG(total) OVER (ORDER BY mes), 2) AS diferencia FROM m ORDER BY mes

### Pregunta
Para 2025, calcula la suma mensual de propina de las órdenes y el acumulado mes a mes. Devuelve mes (AAAA-MM), la suma del mes y el acumulado, en orden cronológico.

### SQL

WITH m AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_time, '%Y-%m') AS mes, SUM(tip) AS total FROM orders WHERE YEAR(order_time) = 2025 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(order_time, '%Y-%m')) SELECT mes, ROUND(total, 2) AS total, ROUND(SUM(total) OVER (ORDER BY mes), 2) AS acumulado FROM m ORDER BY mes

### SQL

WITH m AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(fecha_nacimiento, '%Y-%m') AS mes, SUM(salario) AS total FROM jugadores WHERE YEAR(fecha_nacimiento) = 1996 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(fecha_nacimiento, '%Y-%m')) SELECT mes, ROUND(total, 2) AS total, ROUND(SUM(total) OVER (ORDER BY mes), 2) AS acumulado FROM m ORDER BY mes

### Pregunta
Muestra para cada mes de 2024 la suma de goles del local de los partidos y la diferencia contra el mes anterior. Devuelve mes (AAAA-MM), total y diferencia, en orden cronológico.

### SQL

WITH m AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(fecha, '%Y-%m') AS mes, SUM(goles_local) AS total FROM partidos WHERE YEAR(fecha) = 2024 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(fecha, '%Y-%m')) SELECT mes, ROUND(total, 2) AS total, ROUND(total - LAG(total) OVER (ORDER BY mes), 2) AS diferencia FROM m ORDER BY mes

WITH m AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(chk_in, '%Y-%m') AS mes, SUM(nights) AS total FROM bkg WHERE YEAR(chk_in) = 2025 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(chk_in, '%Y-%m')) SELECT mes, ROUND(total, 2) AS total, ROUND(SUM(total) OVER (ORDER BY mes), 2) AS acumulado FROM m ORDER BY mes

Para 2025, calcula la suma mensual de peso en kg de los envíos y el acumulado mes a mes. Devuelve mes (AAAA-MM), la suma del mes y el acumulado, en orden cronológico.

### SQL
